title: How to get your IP unbanned on HN
guide_zh: HN 对快速请求封禁较敏感，作者提供因 IP 被封后自助解封的办法。
author: pg
excerpt: HN has a hair trigger about banning IPs that request too fast (sorry about that; we don't have a lot of spare performance), so I wrote something people can use to get their IP unbanned once if it gets banned by accident. http://news.ycombinator.com/unban?ip=<ip address> Obviously you have to use it from another IP address, like your phone.

title: Y Combinator interview decisions postponed to November 15
guide_zh: 受风暴延迟申请影响，YC 将面试邀请通知推迟到十一月十五日。
author: pg
excerpt: We originally intended to invite people to YC interviews on November 13. But we pushed the application deadline back by 3 days because of Sandy, and it turns out there is just not that much slack in the system. We need more time to read applications, so we're going to push back our deadline too, to November 15.
